_comment: Relay-hosted bond BRIDGE. Run this bilbycast-bonder co-located with a public bilbycast-relay host. It terminates edge A's multi-leg bond (5G + Starlink + ...), recovers the stream with full ARQ/FEC/reorder, then re-originates a fresh bond toward edge B. Edge A runs a bonded OUTPUT whose legs target this host's ingress ports; edge B runs a bonded (or single-leg) INPUT whose leg(s) this bridge's egress targets. The two hops MUST use different flow_id values. Latency budgets stack across the two hops — size hold_ms accordingly.
